in_marathi.name: Shivesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shivesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shiva, the god of destruction, is the supreme lord who creates, protects and transforms the universe. The name Shivesh means 'God' or 'Lord Shiva'.

in_bengali.name: Shivesh
in_bengali.long_meaning: Shivesh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Shiva, the god of destruction, is the supreme lord who creates, protects and transforms the universe. The name Shivesh means 'God' or 'Lord Shiva'.
